svg.desc: The Sallow Scribe of Brackets: A spindly specter haunting the corridors of a digital scriptorium, forever trapped between a web of requests and a sea of curly braces. Fictional creature inspired by pallets/flask and jqlang/jq. Brain: It obsessively structures its thoughts into tiny, modular web applications.. Body: It moves only by filtering its very essence through complex command-line streams.. Curse: It suffers when a web request demands a response that must be parsed through a command-line processor.. svg.text: FRANKENREPO · MONSTER BIRTH CERTIFICATE
The Sallow Scribe of Brackets
A spindly specter haunting the corridors of a digital
scriptorium, forever trapped between a web of requests
and a sea of curly braces.
BRAIN
It obsessively structures its thoughts into tiny, modular
web applications.
BODY
It moves only by filtering its very essence through
complex command-line streams.
CURSE
It suffers when a web request demands a response that
must be parsed through a command-line processor.
POTENTIALLY USEFUL MUTATION
An archivist could provide a raw JSON log to a
flask-produced web server which then uses jq to transform
the stream into a filtered HTML table for human review.
“Oh, the agony of receiving a request only to find the
payload is buried in a nested bracket nightmare!”
Speculative, not an evaluated recommendation.
It is unclear if the latency of the command-line transformation would break
the web server connection.
pallets/flask · BSD-3-Clause + jqlang/jq · UNKNOWN
